The '''commutube''' was an efficient mass-transit system that served [[Umgul City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umgul/Legends|Umgul]]. It had several lines, including the [[Shedra Line]], [[Katsu Line]], and [[Raceway Line]].
